verdict.rationale: Brex documents both physical and virtual corporate cards (brex-docs-20). Virtual cards can be spun up instantly or in one click, and bulk-created for employees (brex-docs-14, brex-docs-38, brex-docs-30). Spend limits are covered by the Spend Limits API, user monthly limits, and auto-enforced limits (brex-docs-5, brex-docs-32, brex-docs-9), and a community user praises the dynamic card generator (brex-comm-1). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a separate spend limit on each individual card (the evidence shows user- and budget-level limits), evidence that physical cards can be issued to employees quickly, and a hands-on walkthrough of the founder issuance flow.
